title: A Nemzeti Himnusz: Kölcsey és Erkel műve (The National Anthem (Himnusz))
grammar: Heraldic Symbolism, Constitutional Metaphors & Solemn Hymnic Registers

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say who wrote the Himnusz and who composed its music, and when.
I can say what the Day of Hungarian Culture is and why it is on 22 January.
I can say what people usually do while the Himnusz is sung.
I can use the words of this lesson about the Himnusz.
